title: ihave_push.rs and fetch.rs each have separate duplicate dot_stuff implementations
description:
## What / Why
crates/transit/src/import/ihave_push.rs and crates/reader/src/session/commands/fetch.rs each implement their own dot_stuff() function with different semantics (LF-split vs CRLF-split). This duplication is a maintenance risk: if one is fixed (e.g. for the CRLF bug in ihave_push), the other must be checked separately.

## Rewrite
Extract a single canonical dot_stuff(data: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> into stoa_core or a shared reader/transit module. The canonical implementation should handle both CRLF and bare LF input, producing CRLF output. Both call sites should use the shared implementation.
